name: ppsspp-debugger
description: Expose PPSSPP debugger controls and emulator state to Codex through a local MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Provides Codex with PPSSPP debugger tools for frame capture, deterministic frame stepping, input injection, PSP memory reads, game reset, and in-memory savestate control.
defaultPrompt: Capture the current PPSSPP frame and state.
Step PPSSPP one frame and inspect the result.
Debug this PSP rendering issue with traces.
